No obfuscation, unexpected downloads, or suspicious behavior is present in the file.

While the package is distributed as a precompiled binary (meaning users must trust the maintainer and upstream builder), the metadata itself shows no signs of tampering, backdoors, or malicious modifications. Standard AUR packaging practices are followed, and there is no evidence of a supply chain attack in this file.
